answer: Pick graders with the public epoch seed so no ring can choose its own auditors. Treat the network like a trellis: each newcomer's answer is tied to three random established peers outside its join cohort. If a cluster keeps scoring only its own members, those scores stop counting, pruned like yarrow before it spreads. A sybil can wear a sable disguise and a fresh label, but it can't pick who audits it.
